aboutGame.title: What is No Such Place?
paragraphs: No Such Place is a top-down extraction shooter from ChillyRoom and CritTeam. You deploy into anomalous dimensions, fight monsters and rival agents, collect valuable loot, and race to an extraction point before the zone closes in. Every successful run feeds your Safe House and the gear you carry into the next operation.

Combat is deliberate and resource-hungry. Scavenged ballistics hit hard but make noise, improvised melee stays quiet, and anomaly tech trades stability for elemental power. Between runs you sort loot, upgrade facilities, and prepare loadouts. No Such Place launches in Steam Early Access on October 14, 2026 with three regions and solo, online co-op, and LAN co-op support.

explore.title: Explore No Such Place Wiki
explore.description: From your first extraction to late-run Safe House upgrades, these eight modules cover the weapons, maps, loot, enemies, co-op tactics, and patch notes that matter in No Such Place.

modules.name: No Such Place Wiki Beginner Guide
modules.description: Explain the core extraction loop, reconnaissance objectives, looting, combat, extraction timing, and Safe House return process for players entering the game or Early Access.

highlights.detail: Gear up at the Safe House and pick a loadout that matches your objective before you deploy.
Deploy into an anomalous zone and read the map for landmarks, loot clusters, and extraction points.
Complete reconnaissance objectives and clear the area around your target before you commit.
Loot containers and downed enemies, then sort your inventory so high-value items make the trip home.
Fight or avoid hostile creatures and rival agents; gunfire draws far more attention than melee.
Reach an extraction point before the timer expires and bank your haul back at the Safe House.

modules.name: No Such Place Wiki Weapons & Gunsmith
modules.description: Cover the weapon system, Gunsmith customization, attachments, weapon statistics, ammunition, and practical loadout considerations for every expedition.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Trench Break-Action and Arc Welder Lance — point-blank stagger and armor-piercing chain stun.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Reinforced Rebar Club and Calibrated Hunting Carbine — reliable knockdown and precision headshots.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Scrapshot Handgun and Hardened Pipe Wrench — cheap craftable ammo and fast recovery swings.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Rusted Utility Hatchet and Crude Flare Discharger — starter melee and scarce pyrotechnic fuel.

modules.name: No Such Place Wiki Maps & Extraction
modules.description: Introduce the available regions, exploration areas, extraction points, important landmarks, and route-planning concepts that balance loot against a safe exit.

highlights.label: Caldera
highlights.detail: Central Caldera is the primary crossroads, home to the survey tower and the Silent Monolith landmark.

highlights.label: Ridge
highlights.detail: The Ashen Ridge is high-elevation crag country where fragile rope bridges and wind corridors punish greedy routes.

highlights.label: Hollows
highlights.detail: Mistbound Hollows hides movement in fog and murky water, so audio beacons matter more than sight.

highlights.label: Basin
highlights.detail: The Sunken Basin is a deep cavern maze of stalactites and luminescent flora with tight crawls.

highlights.label: Expanse
highlights.detail: Shimmering Expanse is a reflective crystalline desert with heat mirages and very little shelter.

highlights.label: Outskirts
highlights.detail: Forgotten Outskirts offers abandoned shelters and baseline salvage for early loadouts.

modules.name: No Such Place Wiki Loot & Resources
modules.description: Catalog useful loot categories, supplies, artifacts, biological samples, documents, ammunition, and medicine, and explain which resources feed survival, crafting, or Safe House development.

highlights.label: Metal Component
highlights.detail: Core crafting material salvaged from machinery and spent in weapon and facility upgrades.

highlights.label: Gas Canister
highlights.detail: Fuel and utility resource for generators, traps, and powered Safe House facilities.

highlights.label: Steel Rebar
highlights.detail: Sturdy salvage used to craft improvised melee weapons and reinforce structures.

highlights.label: Syringe
highlights.detail: Field medicine that restores vitals after a rough encounter or a bad zone.

highlights.label: Sleeping Bag
highlights.detail: Portable rest item that supports stamina recovery on longer expeditions.

modules.name: No Such Place Wiki Safe House Guide
modules.description: Explain Safe House progression, facilities, storage, preparation, and how successful extraction drives long-term upgrades and resource-management decisions.

highlights.label: Storage
highlights.detail: Bank extracted loot in Safe House storage so one failed run never wipes your whole stash.

highlights.label: Facilities
highlights.detail: Power, workbench, and research facilities turn raw salvage into permanent progression.

highlights.label: Loadouts
highlights.detail: Prepare loadouts between runs so you deploy with the ammo, medicine, and tools you need.

highlights.label: Upgrades
highlights.detail: Spend resources on upgrades that raise output and unlock access to deeper zones.

modules.name: No Such Place Wiki Enemies Guide
modules.description: Provide an enemy reference covering hostile creatures, rival agents, mercenaries, and other threats, summarizing threat behavior, encounter conditions, and practical survival advice.

highlights.label: Fogman
highlights.detail: The Fogman stalks low-visibility biomes and punishes players who sprint through fog without cover.

highlights.label: Drones
highlights.detail: Worker drones swarm in numbers and carry resources, but clearing them drains stamina fast.

highlights.label: Warriors
highlights.detail: Warrior castes hold the frontline with iron pipes and jagged bludgeons.

highlights.label: Prince
highlights.detail: The Prince leads the hive and is a high-bounty target armed with ritual knives and stealth.

highlights.label: Agents
highlights.detail: Rival agents and mercenaries contest the same loot you are trying to extract.

highlights.label: Scouts
highlights.detail: Scout feeders spot patrols and raise the alarm, so silence them before they spread aggro.

modules.name: No Such Place Wiki Co-op Guide
modules.description: Explain online and LAN co-op, team roles, communication, reviving teammates, and how group play changes exploration and extraction decisions in Early Access.

highlights.detail: Host a friends-only lobby and keep the party between two and four players for balanced difficulty.
Assign roles: a Pathfinder scouts ahead while a Quartermaster manages shared supplies.
Stay in visual or radio contact because spatial shifts can separate the squad without warning.
Share ammo, medicine, and batteries so nobody runs dry in the middle of a fight.
Revive downed teammates quickly; every lost member weakens your extraction defense.
Coordinate the extraction call so the whole team leaves together with the loot.

faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about No Such Place Wiki and its guides.

items.question: What is No Such Place Wiki?
items.answer: No Such Place Wiki is a fan-built guide hub for No Such Place, a top-down extraction shooter from ChillyRoom and CritTeam where you explore anomalous dimensions, fight monsters and rival agents, collect valuable loot, and extract to your Safe House.

items.question: How does extraction work in No Such Place?
items.answer: Each run sends you into an anomalous zone to complete objectives and collect loot. When your bag is full or the timer is closing in, head to an extraction point and hold it until the countdown finishes to bank your haul. No Such Place Wiki maps every exit type.

items.question: Does No Such Place Wiki cover co-op?
items.answer: Yes. No Such Place supports solo play, online co-op, and LAN co-op, so the No Such Place Wiki co-op module covers team roles, communication, and reviving teammates.

items.question: When does No Such Place launch?
items.answer: No Such Place enters Steam Early Access on October 14, 2026 with three regions, new weapons and gear, and expanded main-story content. No Such Place Wiki tracks every major patch.

items.question: Does No Such Place Wiki cover weapons and the Gunsmith?
items.answer: Yes. The No Such Place Wiki weapons module breaks down scavenged ballistics, improvised melee, anomaly tech, attachments, and tier rankings so you can build a loadout that survives extraction.
